classification_rules.barrel: primitive 1 centerline island, >=150 tris, narrow X, long source-Y extent, source-Z thickness <0.003; exact island has 236 triangles
classification_rules.wheels: primitive 3 repeated 108-triangle islands, narrow X at either side; seven per side, numbered front (+Godot Z) to rear
classification_rules.turret: whole components centered within source X +/-0.0076 and source Y [-0.0115,0.0155], reaching source Z >=0.004; includes raised central shell and detail islands

notes: The turret mask is geometric, not semantic; inspect Turret component bounds in the preview before gameplay integration.

All surfaces preserve their original material and attribute values; component triangles are not cut.
